title: Give images their size
summary: Image width and height tell the browser the picture's shape before it finishes loading.
introduction: Image width and height tell the browser the picture's shape before it finishes loading. Your task: Find the width and height of a local photo.
learningObjectives: Find the width and height of a local photo.
Explain the example for give images their size

blocks.text: Image width and height tell the browser the picture's shape before it finishes loading. That lets the browser keep the right amount of space.

Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.

blocks.title: Give images their size

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `max-width: 100%` stops the image or box growing wider than its available parent width.
`height: auto` lets the height follow the image's shape when its width changes.

blocks.text: The browser can reserve a 3-to-2 shaped area before garden.jpg loads.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use the real aspect ratio. Wrong dimensions can make the space change again when styles or content arrive.
